summary: Iteration 3 viral-hook additions fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (8 regression + 2 new for headline & savings_vs_budget). /api/optimize now returns `headline` (share-ready one-liner) and `savings_vs_budget` (budget - total_price) for every option — both at £500 (under-budget → 'You save £125' copy) and £200 (over-budget → 'over your £200 budget' copy). Frontend: Home budget-preset chips (300/500/750/1000/1500) all render and tapping £1000 correctly updates budget-value to '£1000'. Destination input shows the blue-tinted 'Anywhere' highlight by default. /results renders the dark verdict-banner with 'VERDICT · £500 BUDGET · Palma de Mallorca for £375.' + 'You save £125' stats row (COMBOS 112 / MEDIAN £617 / YOU SAVE £125). All three trip cards show savings-chip (cheapest £125 UNDER, best-value £124 UNDER, lowest-risk £86 UNDER YOUR £500 BUDGET). Trip detail renders trip-headline ('£500 budget → Palma de Mallorca for £375. You save £125.') plus both share-trip-btn and save-trip-btn icon buttons; share tap does not crash. Regression save flow still works (save-trip-btn → POST /api/trips/save 200 OK).

react_native_issues.issue: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` console warning still logs on initial app mount, even though the problem statement says it was fixed on /loading. Cosmetic only — no functional impact. Likely a lingering `pointerEvents="none"` prop on an Animated.View somewhere (worth grepping the codebase).

action_items: Optional: `grep -R "pointerEvents=" /app/frontend/app /app/frontend/src` and move any remaining prop-based usage to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to fully silence the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: results.tsx verdict-banner text is built manually with if/else on savings_vs_budget instead of rendering `cheapest.headline` directly — means the backend `headline` field is only surfaced in trip detail. Cheap to DRY by rendering `cheapest.headline` (or exposing verdict_headline on the API) to keep banner + share copy aligned.

@react-native-community/slider is 5.2.0 but Expo expects 5.0.1 (seen in expo stderr). Not breaking today but `npx expo install @react-native-community/slider` would align it and pre-empt future SDK drift.
src/store.ts still hard-codes the 'tripopt:active_trip' key in three screens (noted in iteration_2). Not regressed, still worth DRYing.
seed_data_creation: One trip saved via save-trip-btn during detail test (Palma de Mallorca £375). Not explicitly deleted this run — can be cleared with DELETE /api/trips/{id} if next test needs a clean list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 3 viral-hook features are green on web preview @ 390x844: budget-preset chips, Anywhere highlight, verdict-banner + stats on /results, savings-chip on every card, trip-headline + share-trip-btn on /trip/[id]. Backend `headline` + `savings_vs_budget` fields validated for both under- and over-budget scenarios. Only leftover noise is the pointerEvents deprecation warning on initial bundle.
